title: The AI Content Creator Crash Course
short: How to Easily Use ChatGPT, Claude and Free AI Tools to Write, Design, and Create Video: Zero Tech Skills Required
excerpt: A zero-to-hero, step-by-step masterclass for beginners, freelancers, and creators who want to write, design, and produce video with AI.
description: Think you need to be a tech genius to use AI? Think again. If you can send a simple text message on WhatsApp, you can master AI.

“The AI Content Creator Crash Course” by Adetoro Sururat Olatayo shows you how to easily write stories, design stunning graphics, and create cinematic videos in minutes. No coding, no complex tech, just simple, step-by-step formulas for beginners.
features: Write anything: posts, emails, stories, and more
Create stunning graphics: images, covers, art
Make videos and voiceovers with realistic AI voices
The R-C-T-E formula: Role, Context, Task, Expectation
benefits: Create in minutes instead of hours
Work smarter and save time on everyday content tasks
No coding and no prior experience required
